user.title: Meeting indicator
user.description: Add this integration, then open Mac Call Indicator Settings on your Mac and pair using Sign in with Home Assistant or an imported access token. Dashboard/status only sends no actuator commands. Targets must be light, switch, or input_boolean entities, never a person or read-only sensor.

data.name: Device name
data.target_entity: Target entity ID (blank for dashboard only)
data.idle_off: Color light: turn off when idle instead of using idle color
data.offline_action: When reports stop: off or hold previous output

error.wrong_entity_type: Target domain must match the selected output type.
error.entity_not_found: The target entity does not exist.
error.color_not_supported: This light does not support color. Choose on/off mode.

init.title: Meeting output
init.description: Status only never controls an actuator. Idle color is used only while fresh reports explicitly say no meeting. Lost reports make the meeting entity unavailable.
